title: A tool the customer just paid for can't be opened
detail: After a website purchase + sign-up, Home shows Tasks/Files/HR Active with Open, but /go/task_manager says 'You can't open Tasks — it isn't one of your apps'. Launcher access comes from the identity seed grants (mock/lib/identity.js); workspace subscriptions, trials and seats (mock/apps/admin/*) never grant or revoke app access. Affects every new customer, every trial, every seat change and read-only.
evidence: apps/sos/app/go/[scope]/page.tsx:36; mock/apps/admin.js:63-67 (onRegister creates the workspace only)

title: Subscriptions says 'Renews on' for lines bought with manual renewal
detail: Website checkout showed '1 month · Manual renewal'; USR Subscriptions shows 'Renews on 29 Oct 2026' for HR and Tasks (line.autoRenew false). · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Preserved original manual-renewal fix; do not regress its wording while changing paid lines. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: Website checkout showed '1 month · Manual renewal'; USR Subscriptions shows 'Renews on 29 Oct 2026' for HR and Tasks (line.autoRenew false).

title: Two price authorities: website catalogs vs the platform's plans
detail: The website sells flat package prices from its own catalogs (HR CHF 49/month, bundle savings); the order becomes a 'Pro' plan line shown 'per seat × 1' in USR; renewals and upgrades then follow the platform's resolver (regions, seats, GCC prices). A7 kept prices in the website catalogs, Phase E built the resolver: nothing reconciles them.

title: Sign-up after a guest purchase asks again for name and email
detail: The buyer typed both at checkout seconds earlier; Set up my account opens an empty Create account form. · R0 implementation update (local/code only): The website R0 adapter carries checkout buyer details into account setup; immutable claim linking follows server-confirmed payment. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: The buyer typed both at checkout seconds earlier; Set up my account opens an empty Create account form.

title: Out-of-date copy around the real suite account
detail: Sign-up says 'Account access is simulated in this environment' although it now creates a suite account; the confirmation for a software-only order says 'Service periods begin after onboarding confirms activation in the CRM'. · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Account/service copy separates real suite account access from mock payment and managed-service fulfilment. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: Sign-up says 'Account access is simulated in this environment' although it now creates a suite account; the confirmation for a software-only order says 'Service periods begin after onboarding confirms activation in the CRM'.

title: Home tool cards' links are all named 'Open'
detail: Screen-reader and voice users hear 'Open, Open, Open'; the name should include the tool (Open Tasks). · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Home tool controls name the tool in their accessible label. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: Screen-reader and voice users hear 'Open, Open, Open'; the name should include the tool (Open Tasks).

title: Rail is empty for a new customer although Home says 'or from the rail'
detail: Same root cause as SR-001: the rail lists launcher scopes, which a new customer doesn't get.

title: The website offers no free trial; the workspace does
detail: Every tool in USR offers 'Start 14-day free trial', but the website's only path is to pay. A visitor can't start a trial from the site (spec F-01/F-02 trial flow starts in My Tools after sign-up, which the site never mentions).

title: 'Website Manager' is sold to customers but is OrgTik's internal CMS
detail: The website sells 'Website Manager' (content management, website requests); in the suite WM is OrgTik's own CMS (D-002) and the order is skipped as not_in_suite_yet. What a customer gets is undefined; also no Chats product on the site though the workspace offers a Chat trial, and naming differs (CRM vs Sales, Chat vs Chats).

title: Invoices table hides the Total at tablet width
detail: At 800px the table scrolls sideways and the Total column, the one people look for, is off screen. · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Invoice column order makes the total visible before secondary fields at narrow widths. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: At 800px the table scrolls sideways and the Total column, the one people look for, is off screen.

title: Home fetches /v1/app/tools about ten times on load
detail: The mock log shows ~10 identical GET /v1/app/tools in a row for one Home visit. · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Home uses one cached tool query; server runtime consumers remain part of hosted acceptance. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: The mock log shows ~10 identical GET /v1/app/tools in a row for one Home visit.

title: After starting a trial there is no way to open the tool from its page
detail: /tools/crm switches to Trial with an end date and Choose Pro, but no Open CRM action; the only way on is back to Home (and then SR-001 blocks it). · R0 implementation update (local/code only): Active/trial tools expose their existing /go handoff action from the tool detail surface. Revision-specific hosted acceptance remains open.

review_baseline.detail: /tools/crm switches to Trial with an end date and Choose Pro, but no Open CRM action; the only way on is back to Home (and then SR-001 blocks it).

title: An invited team member can never join the workspace
detail: USR Team > Invite people records the member as invited and shows the seat cost, but no invitation link, token or email exists; SOS /auth/invite only accepts the older staff invitations (FS-SOS-7). The member stays Invited forever; seats, tool access and J2 can't continue.

title: Two separate invitation and people systems
detail: SOS People (identity users, launcher scopes, staff invites with tokens) and USR Team (workspace members, roles, seats) model the same people twice and don't talk to each other: a workspace member has no identity grants, an identity user has no workspace seat.

title: The tools have no customer workspaces: every customer would see the same demo company
detail: Tasks, HR, Sales and Marketing mocks hold one shared dataset with no workspace or tenant field (0 references); Files has 1. A new customer who could open Tasks (SR-001) would see Nile Foods' projects. The platform (USR/ADM) is multi-workspace; the tools are not.
evidence: mock/apps/{tasks,hr,sales,marketing}.js and folders: no workspace/tenant references

title: Past due and read-only stop at the USR banners
detail: A failed renewal moves the workspace to past due and read-only in the platform (lifecycle.js) and USR shows the banner, but no tool reads the workspace state: Tasks, HR, Files and Sales keep accepting changes. Only View-as tokens are refused (server.js readOnlyMiddleware).

title: Launching a tool in ADM doesn't reach the website
detail: ADM moves a tool Coming soon → Beta → Live and USR follows, but the website's products, prices and availability come from its own code catalogs (A7) and the WM only mirrors them; the public site never shows the change.

title: The CRM doesn't know who bought, and a won deal doesn't open a workspace
detail: Website purchases now go to the platform (/v1/app/website-orders), not to Sales; and winning a deal in Sales creates no customer account or workspace (the sales mock has no link to the platform). D-028 wanted one lead pipeline in the CRM.
evidence: mock/apps/sales*: 0 platform references; apps/website AGENTS.md 'Checkout uses the suite account'

title: Hiring and offboarding in HR don't touch suite accounts
detail: Adding an employee doesn't create a suite user, seat or tool access; deleting one doesn't revoke their SOS account or reassign their tasks and files. HR reads identity users only to resolve roles.

title: Files can't be attached in Tasks or Chats; Chats claims it saves to Files
detail: Tasks keeps its own attachments and Chats shares files locally; neither can pick from or save to the Files app. The Chats whiteboard says 'Saved in Files as you draw' but saves nothing.

title: Chats loses everything on reload
detail: Chats is a standalone prototype with in-memory demo data; messages and channels reset on reload, and on Vercel there are no sockets for live delivery.

title: Campaigns don't connect to landing content or leads
detail: Marketing has no link to Website Manager content or to Sales leads (0 references), so a campaign can't point to a page or count the leads it brought.

title: Publishing in the Website Manager doesn't update the hosted website
detail: D-012 decided the website reads the CMS at runtime; the site actually renders a build-time snapshot (scripts/content-pull.mjs → src/content/snapshot.js). A publish needs a pull, a commit and a redeploy; there is no publish webhook.

title: On Vercel, theme and language don't follow you between apps
detail: Theme is a cookie per host (packages/ui theme.tsx) and SOS keeps language in its NEXT_LOCALE cookie (D-033). Locally every app is on localhost, so it seems to work; on Vercel each app is its own domain. The hand-off passes the language into an app, but not the theme, and a change inside an app never reaches SOS or the others.

title: No suite notification centre
detail: Tasks, HR and USR each have their own notifications; nothing collects them, and an event in one app can't reach the person in another (e.g. a task assigned while they're in HR).

title: No search across the suite
detail: Each app searches only itself (some not at all); there's no way to find a person, task, file or customer from the shell.
